name: Cambridge Dictionary
description_short: Free online dictionary with learner-friendly definitions, audio pronunciation in British and American English, real example sentences, and a dedicated Learner's Dictionary at B1-B2 level.
creator: Cambridge University Press & Assessment
internal_notes: Verified via search (direct fetch returned 403, bot-blocked, not down). Basic lookups need no login or payment, free since 1999. Word lists/quizzes are a free but optional account feature, not a paywall on core use, so cost recorded as free rather than freemium.
